nights.title: Strangelove - The DEPECHE MODE Experience Black Celebration 2026
nights.name: Strangelove
nights.extract: Strangelove were an English alternative rock band, formed in Bristol in 1991 comprising singer Patrick Duff, guitarists Alex Lee & Julian Poole, bassist Joe Allen and John Langley on drums. They released two EPs and three albums before disbanding in 1998.

nights.title: glaive - God Save The Three Tour
nights.name: Glaive
nights.extract: Ash Blue Gutierrez, known professionally as Glaive, is an American singer-songwriter. After posting a string of hyperpop songs to SoundCloud during the beginning of the COVID-19 pandemic that earned him a following, he signed a record deal with Interscope Records and released his debut extended play, Cypress Grove, in 2020. His debut album, I Care So Much That I Don't Care at All, was released in 2023. His second album, May It Never Falter, was released in 2024. His third, Y'all, was released in September 2025. A collaborative album with Kurtains called God Save the Three, was released in May 2026. Glaive's fourth solo studio album, Polesden Lacey, is set for release in January 2027.
